dedupe_keys.name: lithium ion cell ageing under a realistic forklift load profile

description: Aalborg University researchers publish ageing and reference-test data for three prismatic lithium-ion cells subjected to a forklift-derived load profile. Four months of field operation were condensed into an approximately two-week cycle, with idle periods removed, current limited to fifty amperes and temperatures raised to 35, 40 or 45 degrees Celsius. The article describes second-by-second cell measurements. Ageing and reference-performance tests were repeated fifty-eight times for two cells and fifty-three times for the third. Mendeley version 2 lists CSV records free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is limited to an accelerated three-cell experiment; the transformed profile and elevated temperatures do not directly establish service life for a forklift fleet. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating load-dependent degradation or maintenance assumptions in logistics equipment and battery simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam offers related storage-system modelling, requiring parameter translation. No data were fetched or degradation curves fitted.
